区块生产者

An entity or node responsible for creating and validating new blocks in a blockchain network, also referred to as a validator or miner, depending on the consensus protocol.

Definition

An entity or node responsible for creating and validating new blocks in a blockchain network, also referred to as a validator or miner, depending on the consensus protocol.

Operational example

Block producers maintain blockchain integrity by validating transactions and are compensated through block rewards or transaction fees.
